advisor_identified: Brian Loring Villa, military and diplomatic historian and professor of history at the University of Ottawa.

evidence.says: The author biography for a contribution coauthored by Villa states: "Brian Loring Villa, PhD (Harvard ’69) is professor of history at the University of Ottawa."

Timothy Wilford, Canada’s Road to the Pacific War (2011), acknowledgments, p. xiii: the book originated in doctoral research at Ottawa; identifies Brian Villa with that university and thanks him for guiding the earlier project to completion.

The Canada Council’s 1972–1973 annual report lists Brian L. Villa, Ottawa, with a history research grant for “Tunisia and the origins of the New French Imperialism: 1878-1882,” corroborating his work on the linked dissertation’s subject.

notes: The advisor’s explicitly stated Harvard PhD in 1969 matches the linked record’s name, institution and year; his documented Tunisia research also fits its subject. The exact dissertation title was not independently verified in a library catalogue, so title is null. Only the HNN author biography explicitly establishes both doctoral institution and year.
